history: Sanya, ancient Yazhou, was once the 'end of the sky and corner of the sea' where exiled officials were sent — today it is China's most famous tropical seaside resort. Yalong Bay is 'the finest bay under heaven'; the Guanyin of the South Sea stands 108 meters tall. Li and Miao culture, the Coconut Dream Corridor and the diving paradise Wuzhizhou Island make it the Hawaii of the East.
importance: Tropical seaside resort · Ends of the Earth
foods: First of Hainan's four famous dishes — best white-cut.
